title: Comprehensive Final Test: C++ Intermediate Level

slides.title: C++ Intermediate Comprehensive Test
slides.prompt: This final test evaluates your knowledge across all C++ Intermediate topics, including STL Containers, STL Algorithms & Ranges, Exception Handling, Move Semantics, Smart Pointers, File I/O Streams, and Modern C++ Features (CPP_225 to CPP_280).

slides.title: Container Choice (CPP_225 / CPP_226)
slides.prompt: Which STL container guarantees contiguous memory storage and fast O(1) random access by index?

slides.title: Map Access (CPP_229)
slides.prompt: Fill in the operator used to access or insert elements by key in std::map.

slides.title: Associative Container Ordering (CPP_228)
slides.prompt: What is the primary difference between std::set and std::unordered_set?
options: std::set stores elements in sorted order (O(log N)), while std::unordered_set uses hash tables (average O(1))
std::set allows duplicate elements, while std::unordered_set does not
slides.correctAnswer: std::set stores elements in sorted order (O(log N)), while std::unordered_set uses hash tables (average O(1))

slides.prompt: Fill in the C++20 view adaptor used to extract elements matching a condition.

slides.title: Value Categories (CPP_249)

slides.prompt: Fill in the utility function used to convert an lvalue into an rvalue reference to enable moving.

slides.title: Rule of Five (CPP_255)
slides.prompt: Which functions make up the C++ 'Rule of Five'?
options: Destructor, Copy Constructor, Copy Assignment, Move Constructor, Move Assignment
Constructor, Destructor, Copy Constructor, Virtual Function, Operator=
Default Constructor, Parameterized Constructor, Copy Constructor, Move Constructor, Destructor
Getter, Setter, Constructor, Destructor, Friend Function
slides.correctAnswer: Destructor, Copy Constructor, Copy Assignment, Move Constructor, Move Assignment

slides.title: Compile-time Constant Evaluation (CPP_274)

slides.title: Safe Sum Container (CPP_277)
slides.prompt: What is std::variant in C++17?
options: A type-safe, type-discriminated union capable of holding one value from specified types
A container that holds any number of heterogeneous objects dynamically
A pointer wrapper for managing optional heap allocations
An algorithm for sorting variant arrays
slides.correctAnswer: A type-safe, type-discriminated union capable of holding one value from specified types

slides.title: Type Traits Inspection (CPP_278)
slides.prompt: Fill in the header name required to inspect type characteristics at compile-time.

slides.title: C++20 Concepts (CPP_279)
slides.prompt: What is the primary function of C++20 Concepts?
options: To place compile-time constraints on template parameters for better type checking and clearer error messages
To speed up execution of recursive functions during runtime
To automatically convert template code to dynamic runtime polymorphism
To enforce garbage collection on smart pointers
slides.correctAnswer: To place compile-time constraints on template parameters for better type checking and clearer error messages
